title: Prediction Market Betting on Drug Trials and Approvals Sparks Concern About Undermining Research
summary: Prediction markets on Kalshi and Polymarket now let people wager money on drug approvals. Kalshi also plans to allow bets on clinical trial results.
body_markdown: Prediction markets on Kalshi and Polymarket now let people wager money on drug approvals. Kalshi also plans to allow bets on clinical trial results.
